description: This file defines the TypeScript interface 'PatchedImportLog' and functions for JSON serialization/deserialization related to import logs, including handling of associated 'Keyword' objects.

methods.name: instanceOfPatchedImportLog
methods.description: Checks if a given object implements the PatchedImportLog interface.

methods.name: PatchedImportLogFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a PatchedImportLog object from a JSON object.

methods.name: PatchedImportLogFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Creates a PatchedImportLog object from a JSON object with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: PatchedImportLogToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a PatchedImportLog object to JSON.
